TOOLS.name: spend_report
TOOLS.description: What eve has spent on models and services: today, yesterday, this month, the features that cost most, and OpenRouter's own figure. Use it when the owner asks what eve cost or spent, what their bill for eve is, or what a task cost; answer from it.

TOOLS.name: daily_rundown
TOOLS.description: The owner's daily brief, written from today's mail, calendar, todos and deadlines together. Use it when the owner asks for their rundown, brief or overview of the whole day. One source alone (just the calendar, just the mail) is that app's own tool. It hands the message to the rundown, which writes the brief itself.

TOOLS.name: claude_relay
TOOLS.description: Connect this chat to a Claude Code session already running on the Mac, so what the owner texts is typed into it and its replies come back here (on), or end that (off). on joins the only running session, and otherwise sends the owner buttons to pick or start one.

session.description: The project folder the owner named, or empty.

TOOLS.name: codex_relay
TOOLS.description: Codex, the coding agent, by name: open it in one of the owner's project folders and chat with it here ("open codex in eve"). on starts it (with no folder, the owner picks from a list), off closes it, status says which folder is connected.

folder.description: The project folder the owner named, or empty.

TOOLS.name: set_stealth
TOOLS.description: Stealth mode at the desk: on, eve acts asleep (quiet, face idle) until woken; off wakes it. Use it when the owner asks eve to go quiet or sleep, or to wake up.

TOOLS.name: open_apps
TOOLS.description: Send the button that opens eve's Mini App, home of the apps eve made for the owner. Use it when the owner wants to open or see those apps.

TOOLS.name: pair_eve_link
TOOLS.description: Send the link that pairs Eve Link, the owner's app on their phone or iPad, with eve: for connecting, pairing or linking a device to Eve Link. new_link true makes a fresh link and the old one stops working: only when the owner asks for a new one.

FILE_TOOLS.name: read_file
FILE_TOOLS.description: Read a plain-text file on the owner's Mac (a .txt, .md, .csv, .json, code or a log): its text, up to about 12,000 characters. Home folder only; hidden folders are off limits. list_files finds the path when the owner names the file only roughly.
